title: AgentSessionEvent
description: One row from the agent_session_events table (foundation/session_manager.py), as returned by GET /sessions/{session_id}/events.

event_type.description: One of the event types recorded by agent_runtime.graph / application_ui.api, e.g. model_call, model_interpretation, threshold_recommendation, tool_invocation, tool_result, user_request, human_decision, evidence_item, final_finding, workflow_error, workflow_timing.

payload.description: Event-type-specific JSON payload; shape varies by event_type and is not further constrained here.
